HomePageSettings.StoryQuote: My business is 10:16 automotive. I own and operate a window tint and automotive cosmetic company. We primarily do window tint, wraps and ceramic coatings. I’ve been in this business since 2020 this company was formed January of this year. We are partnered with and certified through System X ceramic protections and Geoshield is our primary tint supplier. I’m hoping to move from my home shop to a full shop this coming year pending growth of the company.
HomePageSettings.StoryAttribution: Donny Bliss, Owner & 6-Year U.S. Army Veteran

AboutPageSettings.Heading: Discipline In Every Detail
AboutPageSettings.Subheading: Founded by 6-Year U.S. Army Veteran Donny Bliss
AboutPageSettings.LeadText: Bringing military standards of precision, accountability, and integrity to automotive cosmetics across Cleveland and Bradley County, Tennessee.
WhoIAmBullets: Founded and operated by Donny Bliss, a 6-year United States Army veteran.
In the automotive cosmetic industry since 2020, officially incorporating 10:16 Automotive in January 2026.
Certified System X ceramic protection installation center.
Authorized Geoshield primary tint supplier and precision film specialist.
Committed to moving from our home shop to an expanded commercial shop this year.
WhyStartedParagraphs: We started 10:16 Automotive to provide vehicle owners with a higher standard of craftsmanship—one built on military discipline rather than quick turnover.
Every window tint installation is hand-inspected, every wrap corner is tucked with factory-level care, and every ceramic coating cures under specialized hexagon lighting.
AboutPageSettings.ClosingQuote: Relentless attention to detail is not an option; it is our standard.
AboutPageSettings.ClosingText: Honored to protect and style vehicles for our neighbors across Cleveland, Chattanooga, and Southeast Tennessee.
AboutPageSettings.ThankYouNote: Thank you for supporting our veteran-owned business!

ServicesPageSettings.Heading: Specialized Cosmetic Capabilities
ServicesPageSettings.LeadText: Precision window tinting, custom vinyl wraps, and certified System X ceramic protection installed with military discipline.

Services.Title: Geoshield Precision Window Tint
Services.Description: Ceramic and carbon automotive films providing 99.9% UV block, up to 88% infrared heat rejection, and crystal-clear nighttime visibility.
